name: qfd_dv_s8_crh_rp1

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every input and every output at its pin (vm8 pin registers, priced); a flow pin register would add a second, unpriced edge

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands rst_n in two registered stages (rl0 -> rl1) and rl1 resets only the sticky fault register

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: RTL registers every input and output at its pin (= vm8 pin registers); rst_n lands rl0 -> rl1 and resets only the sticky fault; no combinational pin arc
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: PASS (by floorplan): outline 259.2 x 276.48, every pin <= 276 um from any sink; gate wire_reach checks 405 um
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: OWED fresh mapped native census on new2bit half/bank controls, then qualified gate; oldCRH census not alias.
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: = vm8 (census depth recorded); no logic before a macro pin except the 2-register collision compare
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: all > 2 kb state in SRAM macros
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS: x on 43.2, y on 8.64, macro channels >= 20 um, S band 86.4, aspect 1.07, faces W 456 / 276.5 = 1.6/um, S 542 / 259.2 = 2.1/um
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: ONE CTS root (S-centre ck) over the whole leaf = one region; pin-flop spread <= 80 TT+FF judged in the gate; every crossing to a slice2 neighbour lands in a parent mesochronous ring; io_hold_margin 0.03
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: Same CRH sequential stages; focused actual-RP-to-CRH SRAM eight-beat byte/bank test passed with two mutants. Selected s8 LP programme ages OWED (4 new landings/pad3 D4), no whole-parent age claim.

fill_reason.pin_bound: macro- and pin-bound leaf: the dense S face (W 456 / 276.5 = 1.6/um, S 542 / 259.2 = 2.1/um) carries the registered table/VM write bus; the leaf is kept <= 259.2 um wide on that face so every pin register sits <= 130 um from the S-centre clock pin (r1 leaves 302-475 um wide: pin-flop spread 107-146 ps); the outline is set by the face width x macro column, not by the std-cell area

structural_change: Existing CRH with c0f8097f3 CRH1 half-write recovery: two kept half/bank selector bits at same capture age, per-bank WCE, legal half-address fault. Same ABI/read stages/two SRAMs/outline; new source must close independently.

job.purpose: Existing CRH1 exact half-bank write recovery for selected s8 split source; unique new closure, no old view alias
